results_workbook_stale.why: GET /api/results/workbook.xlsx (results-workbook issue 01) refuses with 409 while a solve runs, and when the results do not match the current inputs (workflow_tools.solve_freshness: inputs changed, or no fingerprint recorded), as create_chart refuses a stale run. The caller re-runs the model, or asks again with stored=true to export the stored run, which About then labels as such.

unknown_result_view.why: GET /api/results/workbook.xlsx refuses with 422 a views= id that is not a Results-panel view of a card (results_workbook.registry.workbook_views); the message lists the valid ids and the caller asks again with them.
